question: Should this PR merge after documenting the `auth/token/lookup-self` capability requirement for custom Vault token policies, thereby making the provider-outage classification contract explicit?
rationale: The code intentionally changes how ambiguous Vault 403 responses are surfaced; maintainers must confirm the operator-facing compatibility contract rather than infer it from tests alone.

options.title: Document and approve the contract
